features.title: FastAPI/React skeleton with binary upload and decompile endpoint
acceptance: POST /api/decompile accepts binary upload and returns decompilation result
Frontend shows upload form and displays decompilation output

features.title: Vtable function call resolution in decompiler (issue #516)
acceptance: Decompiler recognizes vtable pointer in struct/class
Indirect calls through vtable show resolved function names
UI allows marking struct field as vtable

features.title: JMP with PUSH return address recognition (issue #5747)
acceptance: Decompiler recognizes PUSH+JMP as CALL with return
Control flow continues after call instead of returning

features.title: Cross-segment string display in decompiler (issue #4865)
acceptance: String references resolved across memory segments
Decompiler shows string literals instead of addresses
